prompt: LH09-0193. Generate ONE isolated Japanese editable-design raster candidate for an Asana CSV import table header. References: original screenshot and its inspected 1697×46 crop control exact layout; Japanese mock controls translated wording only. Reproduce a very thin horizontal white strip, edge-to-edge with no surrounding blank canvas, no card framing or shadows. Five columns: 制作物の識別子 (55.3% width), A-like text-type icon 制作物の名称 with right down-chevron (11.1%), circled-check type icon 形式 with right chevron (11.1%), A-like text-type icon 掲載先 with right chevron (11.1%), circled-check type icon 状態 with right chevron (11.4%). Original circled-check icons and A type glyphs matter; mock's generic 字 and bare checks are not authoritative. Very fine light-gray top/bottom and vertical column dividers, gray regular text, left aligned, vertically centered, compact source row height. White closed selectors with no colored fill. Apple Design clarity and compact hierarchy, no invented controls. Official style: Meiryo Regular14/24, metadata12/16, tracking0, restrained neutral grayscale; forest green only where actual selected/primary state exists (none here). Preserve meaningful source geometry, wording, visible state. No data rows, popup, pointer, watermark, app chrome, decorative mint background, or extra labels. Output the thin 1697:46 proportion without excess outer vertical padding.
